articles.title: Arshdeep, Gurnoor and Nabi to Stay Back for India's New Zealand Test Preparations
articles.excerpt: India will retain three ODI pacers in New Zealand as net bowlers and reserves for the two-Test series, while five Test squad members skip the last two ODIs to open a Wellington camp on November 11.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian fans in New Zealand and across the diaspora following this tour, the decision to hold back in-form pacers underlines how seriously India are taking a rare chance to win a Test series in seaming conditions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tickner and Ferguson Ruled Out as New Zealand Reshuffle Again for India ODIs
articles.excerpt: Blair Tickner must serve a seven-day stand-down despite being cleared of concussion, Lockie Ferguson is out for the series with a calf tear, and Kristian Clarke comes in as cover with India leading 2-0 before Tuesday's Hamilton match.
articles.nri_angle: For India fans following the tour from abroad, Tuesday's third ODI in Hamilton is now a series decider in effect: India lead 2-0, and a win closes the five-match series against a reshuffled home attack.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Shourya Ambure Wins Bronze, India's First Track Medal at Dakar Youth Olympics
articles.excerpt: The 17-year-old from Maharashtra clocked a personal best 13.59 seconds in the women's 100m hurdles final, missing silver by 0.02 seconds as India's only track and field athlete at the Games.
articles.image_caption: Shourya Ambure, wearing her AMBURE race bib and India kit, holds the Indian flag after the women's 100m hurdles final at Dakar 2026. She won bronze in a personal best 13.59 seconds, India's first track and field medal of the Games.
articles.nri_angle: Ambure's medal gives Indian athletics a new junior name to follow toward the senior circuit — she has now medalled at the Asian U18 Championships, the Asian Youth Games and the Youth Olympics inside 18 months.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: IPL Trades: Gujarat, Delhi Discuss Ashutosh Sharma Swap Ahead of Retention Deadline
articles.excerpt: Cricbuzz reports Gujarat approached Delhi months ago for the Rs 3.8 crore finisher and Delhi may now revisit the offer — while a counter-report insists he is not up for trade at all.
articles.nri_angle: IPL trade season is followed closely by diaspora fans ahead of the 2027 mini-auction; the November 17 deadline is the date that decides squad shapes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 'It Was a Tricky Wicket': Santner Reflects as India Edge Wellington ODI
articles.excerpt: New Zealand's captain praised both bowling attacks after a low-scoring second ODI in Wellington, where India won by four runs under DLS to lead the series 2-0.
articles.nri_angle: India's tour of New Zealand is a marquee series for Indian fans in New Zealand and across the diaspora following the five-match ODI contest.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hamza Zahoor's Unbeaten Century Lifts Pakistan Past India in U19 Asia Cup
articles.excerpt: Pakistan recovered from 61 for 5 to chase 208 in Muscat, as Zahoor's 100 not out off 108 balls outshone Arjun Rajput's century for India.
articles.image_caption: Pakistan Under-19 players celebrate on the field during the U19 Asia Cup match against India in Muscat. Pakistan chased 208 to win by three wickets, led by Hamza Zahoor's unbeaten century.
articles.nri_angle: A new chapter of the India-Pakistan rivalry at under-19 level, followed closely by cricket fans across the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bangladesh Opener Shadman Islam Ruled Out of South Africa Tour With Ankle Injury
articles.excerpt: Shadman Islam twisted his left ankle fielding in the Sylhet Test against West Indies, leaving Bangladesh a batter short; team medical staff suspect a hairline fracture and ligament damage that could sideline him for three to four weeks.
articles.nri_angle: Bangladesh's full-format South Africa tour is a marquee series for South Asian cricket fans in the diaspora, and the visitors have lost their in-form Test opener before it starts.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

Second ODI, St George's Park, Gqeberha

articles.title: Irfan Pathan Backs CSK to Keep Rs 14.20 Crore Prashant Veer for IPL 2027
articles.excerpt: Reports say Chennai Super Kings may release the 20-year-old all-rounder to free up funds after a quiet first season — but in a retain-or-release exercise for ESPNcricinfo, former India all-rounder Irfan Pathan kept Veer on the roster.
articles.image_caption: Irfan Pathan indian cricketer with amitabh shah from yuva unstoppable. In an ESPNcricinfo retain-or-release exercise covering 23 players across the 10 franchises, Irfan Pathan retained 16 — including Veer — and released seven, among them Matheesha Pathirana and Trent Boult.
articles.nri_angle: IPL retention season is followed closely across the diaspora, and CSK's call on its two Rs 14.20 crore youngsters will shape the December mini-auction.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India A Declare at 464, Lead New Zealand A by 428 on Day 2
articles.excerpt: Fifties from Jurel, Tilak Varma and Washington Sundar built a commanding total in Lincoln before Prasidh Krishna struck twice on his return from injury.
articles.nri_angle: India A's fringe Test contenders — Jurel, Tilak and a returning Prasidh Krishna — are auditioning for the senior series against New Zealand starting November 19.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rajat Patidar Withdraws From India A Squad, Ayush Badoni Named Replacement
articles.excerpt: Patidar told the BCCI he should not be considered for 50-over selection as he manages existing injuries; Badoni joins the squad and Rinku Singh becomes vice-captain.
articles.nri_angle: Cricket fans in the diaspora following India A in Doha can track the revised squad and the November 19-29 tournament dates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hardik-Arshdeep Swap Nears Completion as Mumbai, Punjab Exchange Formal Interest
articles.excerpt: Cricbuzz reports both franchises have exchanged Expressions of Interest and both players have consented, leaving only contract exchange and BCCI confirmation — with no third player involved.
articles.nri_angle: For IPL fans in the diaspora, the swap redraws two squads they follow every spring: Mumbai's pace attack around Bumrah and Punjab's middle order under Shreyas Iyer.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gukesh Visits Tirumala Temple Ahead of World Chess Championship Title Defence
articles.excerpt: The 20-year-old world champion offered prayers at Tirumala on November 6 before facing Javokhir Sindarov in a 14-game title match in Geneva from November 24 to December 12.
articles.image_caption: World champion D Gukesh at the 46th FIDE Chess Olympiad. Gukesh visited the Tirumala temple ahead of his World Chess Championship title defence.

sources.label: The Times of India via Jammu News Portal

articles.nri_angle: Indian chess fans worldwide get a defined three-week window — November 24 to December 12 in Geneva — to follow the youngest title match in chess history.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jaiswal Smashes Second Straight Century for India A in New Zealand
articles.excerpt: The opener's 102 at Lincoln follows his unbeaten 155 at Hagley Oval — a timely return to form 12 days before India's Test series opens in Wellington.
articles.nri_angle: Jaiswal's form is the lead story for diaspora fans planning to watch the Wellington Test — India's opener arrives at the series with consecutive hundreds behind him.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Taniya Wins Silver in Beach Wrestling's Youth Olympic Debut at Dakar
articles.excerpt: The Indian wrestler lost the women's 75kg final 1-2 to China's Zhao Min after four straight wins — becoming the first Indian to medal in the sport at a Youth Olympics.
articles.nri_angle: An Indian teenager's silver in a brand-new Olympic discipline is the kind of first a diaspora audience follows closely — Indian wrestling keeps producing new names on new stages.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
